hypotheses.claim: A dynamically linked admission program cannot be its own earliest loader-environment authority; a trusted parent must construct or attest its environment before exec.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Rejecting LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT and LD_LIBRARY_PATH in the shell is sufficient because contaminated invocations still terminate before product logic.
hypotheses.discriminator: Place a sentinel preload before the shell, then compare shell-only rejection with a dedicated parent/service that removes loader controls before exec and binds parent executable, unit bytes and child environment.
hypotheses.falsifier: No attacker-controlled code executes before the shell rejection across held-out loader controls and /etc/ld.so.preload, or the proposed parent cannot establish a cleaner antecedent boundary.

hypotheses.claim: SQLite production admission needs two independent keys: a reviewed release identity and deployment-owned artifact/anchor authority, followed by live mapped-object equality.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Exact reviewed version/source-id alone is enough because same-source builds are operationally equivalent.
hypotheses.discriminator: Hold release identity constant while changing compile flags/library bytes, then hold bytes constant while changing authorization anchor; require both axes plus live inode/hash before WAL open.

hypotheses.claim: ProductStart cannot be accepted until a distinct productive parent/service exists, is observable and binds the loader→launcher→guard→SQLite lineage.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The CI runner can serve as the production parent because it already supplies a clean loader environment and exact checkout.
hypotheses.discriminator: Install or identify a dedicated product unit, then compare its immutable configuration, user, environment, cgroup and live child lineage against the Actions runner while replaying contaminated-environment and restart controls.

hypotheses.claim: Handoff confirmation requires identity, exact release epoch, semantic IDLE state, empty execution context and CAS as a conjunction; no subset safely represents current idleness.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Explicit epoch equality alone is sufficient and the semantic-idle checks duplicate the execution gate.
hypotheses.discriminator: Factorially lesion each conjunct across ABA, successor-BUSY, restart and concurrent confirmation; observe unauthorized clear versus availability cost.

novel_concepts.name: Preload Antecedent Trust
novel_concepts.definition: The earliest authority must exist before the dynamic loader can execute caller-selected code.

novel_concepts.name: Two-Key SQLite Admission
novel_concepts.definition: Reviewed semantic release identity and independently owned deployment artifact authority are both required before live-object admission.

novel_concepts.name: No Parent, No ProductStart
novel_concepts.definition: Absence of a separately observable productive execution parent is itself a release-blocking negative result.

novel_concepts.name: Semantic Idle Conjunction
novel_concepts.definition: Current idleness is the intersection of release epoch, presence state, cleared execution context and successful CAS.
